subject: POC requirements & prompt/log handoff — LexGrid evaluation
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Cara Johnson <cara@lexgrid.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 17:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: POC scope & next steps (LexGrid call - Feb 26)

Hi Cara — thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we have a single source of truth for the POC kickoff.

High-level objective
- Validate Redwood inference for LexGrid’s customer search assistant use case (50–200k queries/day projected) and measure retrieval+generation quality against your production prompts.

Primary success criteria (customer-defined)
1) Quality: F1 / exact-match thresholds for canonical prompts as discussed; target: >=92% for the top-1 template group.
2) Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end generation < 350ms on the dedicated config we demoed.
3) Safety / PII handling: no high-severity leaks in the provided prompt sample set.
4) Cost profile: tokens/response and avg cost per 1k requests within your target budget (we’ll quantify after first run).

Eval plan & deliverables
- LexGrid provides: representative prompt set (CSV) + recent query logs (redacted if needed). Template: id, prompt, context_tags, expected_output_pattern (regex), priority.
- Redwood executes: evaluation harness that runs the prompt set across 3 model variants, records latency, token counts, and computes quality metrics against your expected patterns.
- Deliverables: evaluation report (metrics + example transcripts), raw run logs (anonymized), and suggested model/config recommendation.

Timeline & ownership
- Requested from LexGrid by: Thu Mar 4 (full prompt CSV + logs).
- Redwood evaluation window: 5 business days after we receive the full dataset.
- Target internal sync (redwood): Mon Mar 9 to review results with your team.
- Owners: Rishi (sales / POC coord), Monica (solutions / eval lead), LexGrid owner: Cara (data & access).

Secure transfer
- We can accept S3 presigned URLs, SFTP, or upload to our secure intake form (drive link below). If data includes PII, please redact at source or flag fields — we will not request raw PII.

Attachments included with this email: lexgrid_prompt_samples.csv (sample template), lexgrid_query_logs_20260225.json (small extract).

Next steps for Cara
- Share the full prompt CSV + logs by Mar 4 (or tell us blockers).
- Confirm procurement contact for NDA, if not already looped.
- Let us know if you need a hardened private deployment for the run (we can accommodate).

Thanks — I’ll follow up once procurement completes the NDA.

Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0113
From: Cara Johnson <cara@lexgrid.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@lexgrid.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 20:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: POC scope & next steps (LexGrid call - Feb 26)

Thanks Rishi — great summary. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Logs: the query logs include user_ids and timestamps. We will redact user_ids but keep session ids — is session id sufficient for grouping?
2) PII: we cannot provide any raw customer emails or SSNs. We will run a redaction pass, but if you have recommended redaction rules please send them.
3) Transfer: procurement prefers S3 presigned links. Will that work for you?

We’ll aim to send an initial batch of ~1k prompts + a 1-day log extract by Mar 3, then the full set by Mar 4 pending legal.

Cara
Cara Johnson
Head of Product — Search | LexGrid, Inc.
cara@lexgrid.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Cara Johnson <cara@lexgrid.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: POC scope & next steps (LexGrid call - Feb 26)

Hi Cara — S3 presigned links are perfect. A few quick notes on redaction and transfer: 

Redaction guidance
- Remove direct identifiers (emails, SSNs, payment tokens).
- Session IDs are sufficient for grouping conversation context; please keep them.
- If removing context reduces prompt quality, flag examples for us so we can treat them as synthetic during evaluation.

S3 presigned upload steps (recommended)
1) Upload files to your internal bucket.
2) Generate presigned PUT for each artifact (prompt CSV, logs).
3) Send links to rishi@redwood.com with a short manifest (file name / row count).

Data format we expect
- prompt CSV: columns: id, prompt, context_tags (comma-separated), expected_output_pattern, priority
- logs JSON: array of compact entries {timestamp, session_id, prompt_id, prompt_text, response, tokens} — the sample attached shows the minimal fields.

If it helps, Monica has a small script we can run on your end to auto-redact obvious PII fields before upload. Monica — can you share that script with Cara?

We’ll queue the evaluation as soon as we have the manifest + links and signed NDA. ETA for results: 5 business days after we get the dataset.

Best,
Rishi
From: Cara Johnson <cara@lexgrid.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: LexGrid Procurement <procurement@lexgrid.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 17:40:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: POC scope & next steps (LexGrid call - Feb 26)

Thanks — we’ll do two deliveries:
- Batch 1 (by Tue Mar 3): ~1k representative prompts + 1-day log extract for quick smoke testing.
- Batch 2 (by Thu Mar 4): Full prompt set + 7-day log extract.

Procurement will send the signed NDA to procurement@redwood.com (or the shared drive link) — looping them here.

Question: once you receive Batch 1, how quickly can Redwood run a smoke eval and share preliminary feedback?

Cara
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 09:25:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: LexGrid POC — task assignment & eval plan

Internal only — copying Marissa for CS coordination. Action items for the POC once we receive Batch 1 & 2: 

Monica:
- Prep eval harness using the prompt template (lexgrid_prompt_samples.csv). Include: runner for model variants, tokenizer-based token counting, latency capture, and regex-based matching for expected_output_pattern.
- Share the small redaction script with LexGrid and provide S3 upload checklist.
- Estimate compute footprint and confirm whether hosted or dedicated infra is appropriate; include cost estimate for the 5-day run.

Marissa:
- Prepare the customer-facing eval report template and a short executive summary slide.
- Coordinate scheduling for the Mar 9 sync and draft an agenda.

Notes / gating metrics:
- Smoke eval (Batch 1): deliver within 48 hours of batch receipt — include top-level quality flags and any obvious data issues.
- Full eval (after Batch 2): 5 business days for full metrics + recommendations.

Attachments for internal run: eval-runbook.md (internal), run-config-example.json (internal).

Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
